root.description: Final deadline to submit full papers to InC4 2026 (online submission). Ensure formatting and anonymization are correct before uploading. Submissions close at 23:59 local time; late submissions are not accepted.
Acceptance decisions and reviewer feedback for InC4 2026 will be available today (online notification). Check your email and submission portal for your decision and next steps.
Final day to register at early-bird rates for InC4 2026 (online registration). Prices increase after today—secure your ticket now.
Registration closes today for InC4 2026 (online registration). Complete your registration to secure access to sessions and conference materials.
Submit final camera-ready papers with all reviewer fixes applied (online submission). Verify formatting, author list, and metadata. Missing this deadline may affect inclusion in proceedings.
InC4 2026 runs across two days with keynotes, technical sessions, and networking opportunities at CHRIST University, Kengeri Campus, Bangalore.
